question: According to the DJI Matrice 30T manual, what can Signal Lost Action be set to, and under what conditions does Failsafe Return to Home start?

intake.focus: Signal Lost Action and Failsafe Return to Home conditions
intake.reason: Question about DJI M30T manual guidance on lost link and failsafe RTH

brief.short_answer: Signal Lost Action can be set to RTH, land, or hover. Failsafe Return to Home starts automatically after the remote controller signal is lost for more than six seconds.

claims.text: The manual states the action of the aircraft when the remote controller signal is lost can be set to RTH, land, or hover.
claims.quote: action of the aircraft when the remote controller signal is lost can be set to RTH, land, or hover

claims.text: The manual states Failsafe RTH automatically activates after the remote controller signal is lost for more than six seconds.
claims.quote: Failsafe RTH automatically activates after the remote controller signal is lost for more than six seconds
conditions: remote controller signal is lost for more than six seconds

claims.text: The manual states that when the lighting is sufficient and the vision systems are working normally, DJI Pilot 2 will display the RTH path that was generated by the aircraft before the remote controller signal was lost.
claims.quote: When the lighting is sufficient and the vision systems are working normally, DJI Pilot 2 will display the RTH path that was generated by the aircraft before the remote controller signal was lost

claims.text: The manual states when lighting is not sufficient and vision systems are not available, the aircraft will enter Original Route RTH.
claims.quote: When the lighting is not sufficient and the vision systems are not available, the aircraft will enter Original Route RTH

claims.text: The manual states the aircraft will remain in RTH even if the remote controller signal is restored.
claims.quote: The aircraft will remain in RTH even if the remote controller signal is restored
